title: West Coast Mate Check
style: Aussie rap with bouncy 92 BPM boom-bap swing, clipped kick-snare punch and rubbery sub-bass; verse one rides dry and minimal with handclaps and scratched one-shots, pre-chorus tightens with filtered gang shouts, chorus opens with stacked doubles and a shouted hook. Ear candy: coin-click fills, servo beep stabs, and reverse vinyl sweeps into the drop. Bright, gritty, close-mic mix with wide ad-lib throws., rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
From the west side, mate, I’m up with the sparrows
Four-wheel drift past the deli, lace up the cargos
No cap, that’s cooked, if the week gets feral
Still I say “no worries” when the plan goes feral

You call me “bro,” I call you “cuz”
Same old yarn, just a different buzz
Your app says “g’day,” mine says “how ya goin’?”
Type too fast, then the whole thing’s showin’

[Pre-Chorus]
East side, west side, tap that map
Say it one way, then swing it back
One hand up when the inbox chat
You know the vibe, it’s Aussie rap

[Chorus]
Pal app, pal app, where ya at?
West or east, we talkin’ that
Pal app, pal app, don’t be slack
Say it like that, then send it back

[Verse 2]
East coast slang got a quick little snap
“Mad keen,” “too easy,” “reckon that”
West coast text got a slower drawl
“Catch ya later,” then I don’t say much at all

If the crew’s late, I’m “on my way”
If the feed’s dead, I’m “gone today”
One bloke says “shout,” one says “shout out”
Same salt air, just different shout-out

[Pre-Chorus]
East side, west side, tap that map
Say it one way, then swing it back
One hand up when the inbox chat
You know the vibe, it’s Aussie rap

[Chorus]
Pal app, pal app, where ya at?
West or east, we talkin’ that
Pal app, pal app, don’t be slack
Say it like that, then send it back

[Bridge]
From the sand to the surf, we split the same screen
Different words, same grin, same keen
If you’re from the coast, then you know this game
Say it your way, I’ll still know your name

[Chorus]
Pal app, pal app, where ya at?
West or east, we talkin’ that
Pal app, pal app, don’t be slack
Say it like that, then send it back
